title: Beans Poriyal
description: French beans stir-fried with mustard seeds, curry leaves and fresh grated coconut — a dry, everyday South Indian side dish, simple and quick.
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the urad dal and dried red chillies, frying until the dal turns golden.
Add the curry leaves and green chilli, and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add the chopped beans, turmeric and salt, and toss well to coat.
Add the water, cover, and cook on medium-low heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender but still have a slight bite.
Uncover, mix in the grated coconut, and cook for 2 more minutes until any remaining moisture evaporates. Serve warm as a side with rice and sambar.
